ValidationRule.description: Check if the fields "YTD total Franchise", "MTD total Franchise" and "Prior Year total Franchise" are fewer than previous values.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula:
AND ( !$Setup.CIB_Bypass__c.CIB_skip_validationrule__c, OR ( PRIORVALUE(MTD_Total_Franchise__c) - (PRIORVALUE(MTD_Total_Franchise__c) * 0.05) > MTD_Total_Franchise__c, PRIORVALUE(YTD_Total_Franchise__c) - (PRIORVALUE(YTD_Total_Franchise__c) * 0.05) > YTD_Total_Franchise__c, PRIORVALUE(Prior_Year_Franchise__c) - (PRIORVALUE(Prior_Year_Franchise__c) * 0.05) > Prior_Year_Franchise__c,
PRIORVALUE(Cash_Bond_MTD_Total_Franchise__c) - (PRIORVALUE(Cash_Bond_MTD_Total_Franchise__c) * 0.05) > Cash_Bond_MTD_Total_Franchise__c, PRIORVALUE(Cash_Bond_YTD_Total_Franchise__c) - (PRIORVALUE(Cash_Bond_YTD_Total_Franchise__c) * 0.05) > Cash_Bond_YTD_Total_Franchise__c, PRIORVALUE(Prior_Year_Franchise_Cash_Bond__c) - (PRIORVALUE(Prior_Year_Franchise_Cash_Bond__c) * 0.05) > Prior_Year_Franchise_Cash_Bond__c,
PRIORVALUE(FX_MTD_Total_Franchise__c) - (PRIORVALUE(FX_MTD_Total_Franchise__c) * 0.05) > FX_MTD_Total_Franchise__c, PRIORVALUE(FX_YTD_Total_Franchise__c) - (PRIORVALUE(FX_YTD_Total_Franchise__c) * 0.05) > FX_YTD_Total_Franchise__c, PRIORVALUE(Prior_Year_Franchise_FX__c) - (PRIORVALUE(Prior_Year_Franchise_FX__c) * 0.05) > Prior_Year_Franchise_FX__c,
PRIORVALUE(CE_MTD_Total_Franchise__c) - (PRIORVALUE(CE_MTD_Total_Franchise__c) * 0.05) > CE_MTD_Total_Franchise__c, PRIORVALUE(CE_YTD_Total_Franchise__c) - (PRIORVALUE(CE_YTD_Total_Franchise__c) * 0.05) > CE_YTD_Total_Franchise__c, PRIORVALUE(Prior_Year_Franchise_CE__c) - (PRIORVALUE(Prior_Year_Franchise_CE__c) * 0.05) > Prior_Year_Franchise_CE__c ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Franchise values cannot be fewer than existing values
